'''Alderaanian Emera Wine''' was a type of wine that was presumably from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it could be purchased from [[Nenmo's Curios]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
